description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific style in Figma using its unique style key.

key.description: The unique identifier (key) of the style to retrieve. Style keys are 40-character hexadecimal hash strings obtained from the GET /v1/files/{file_key}/styles or GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/styles endpoints. This endpoint only works for styles published in a team library.
key.title: Key

name: get_style

data.description: The main data payload of the response, encapsulating the style's status, error state, and metadata.
data.title: Data

created_at.description: The date and time (in UTC ISO 8601 format) when the style was initially created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: A textual description of the style, often provided by the person who published it.
description.title: Description

file_key.description: The unique identifier of the Figma file where this style is defined.
file_key.title: File Key

key.description: The unique identifier (key) of this style. A 40-character hexadecimal hash string.
key.title: Key

name.description: The human-readable name of the style as it appears in the Figma UI.
name.title: Name

node_id.description: Identifier of the specific node within the Figma file from which this style originates.
node_id.title: Node Id

sort_position.description: A user-defined string that can be used to order styles. Note that Figma itself might not use this field for internal sorting; it's often intended for client-side sorting logic.
sort_position.title: Sort Position

style_type.description: Specifies the type of the style, such as FILL, TEXT, EFFECT, or GRID.
style_type.title: Style Type

thumbnail_url.description: Optional URL for a thumbnail image preview of the style. This can be null if no thumbnail is available.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

updated_at.description: The date and time (in UTC ISO 8601 format) when the style was last modified.
updated_at.title: Updated At

user.description: Information about the Figma user primarily associated with this style (e.g., its creator or last editor).
user.title: User

error.description: Boolean flag indicating if an error occurred. `false` (from the Error enum) signifies a successful request.
error.title: Error

meta.description: An object containing the detailed metadata properties for the requested style.
meta.title: Meta

status.description: HTTP status code of the API response. A value of 200 (from the Status enum) indicates success.
status.title: Status

handle.description: The user's display name or handle in Figma.
handle.title: Handle

id.description: Unique, stable identifier for the user within Figma.
id.title: Id

img_url.description: URL pointing to the user's profile image.
img_url.title: Img Url
